title: Multiplicity one and null symmetric difference give mu_V restricted to O = H^n restricted to spt V cap O
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, U a subset of R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) a rectifiable n-varifold in U with weight mu := V.weight and support Sigma := V.support (H^n := muHE[n]), and O a measurable subset of R^(n+l). Assume theta = 1 mu-a.e. on O (for mu-a.e. x, x in O implies V.mult x = 1) and H^n((M cap O) symmetric-difference (Sigma cap O)) = 0. Then mu restricted to O equals H^n restricted to Sigma cap O (V.weight.restrict O = muHE[n].restrict (V.support cap O)).
lean_statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (O : Set (Amb n ℓ)), MeasurableSet O → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, x ∈ O → V.mult x = 1) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (symmDiff (V.carrier ∩ O) (V.support ∩ O)) = 0 → V.weight.restrict O = (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)).restrict (V.support ∩ O)
